WITH PRODUCTGROUP_SK
AS
(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ProductGroupSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimProductGroup
)
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM PRODUCTGROUP_SK) ProductGroupSK
,NULL AS ProductGroupID
,NULL AS ProductGroupName
,NULL AS ProductGroupDescription
,NULL AS BankSK
,NULL AS BranchSK
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,NULL AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm


FROM
